intent: Complete Phase 5 against the merged Phase 3 and Phase 4 production contracts, including runtime binding, atomic publication, automatic quarantine, repair flow, privacy retention, and the final 100k audit.

findings.title: Committed removals could remain visible after acknowledgement failure
Full rebuild held the new-turn publication gate
Severe telemetry had no production quarantine dispatch
Repair persistence did not revalidate content address
Privacy purge lacked generation-coherent publication facade

residual_risks: Authenticated feedback is intentionally exposed as a trusted service boundary rather than a model-callable host global.
The full index compaction after a removal-only publication remains asynchronous from reader visibility and is recovered at the next turn boundary.

validation.phase5_operations_benchmark: all operation budgets passed at 100k retained events
